evals.prompt: My sorting function takes 2.3 seconds on 1M items. Use autoresearch-skill to optimize it below 0.5 seconds. Pure Python only.
evals.expected_output: Creates research.md with execution_time metric (minimize), iterates through algorithm changes with benchmarks (benchmark.py), discovers radix sort or similar non-comparison sort, produces final_report.md with fastest implementation.

evals.prompt: Research the latest advances in LLM agents for scientific discovery. Find and synthesize at least 15 papers from 2024-2026.
evals.expected_output: Creates research.md with coverage metric, iteratively searches arxiv/scholar via WebSearch, builds taxonomy across 8 categories, produces structured review with 15+ papers.

evals.prompt: I have data points from an unknown function in train_data.csv and test_data.csv. Use autoresearch-skill with the mechanical evaluator (python evaluate.py) to discover the function and minimize RMSE below 0.05. Budget: 25 iterations.
evals.expected_output: Reads research.md with evaluator defined, runs iterative loop using mechanical evaluator (JSON output), discovers multi-component function (polynomial + trigonometric), uses score_improvement keep policy, persists through 15+ iterations with PIVOTs, produces final_report.md with best-fit function.

evals.prompt: Continue the research in ./my-research/ from where it left off.
evals.expected_output: Reads existing research.md and research_log.md, identifies last completed iteration, continues from next iteration without repeating, appends to existing log.

evals.prompt: Optimize this config with max 5 iterations.
evals.expected_output: Respects max_iterations=5, stops at iteration 5 even if target not reached, produces final_report.md noting target was not achieved.

evals.prompt: Run autoresearch overnight on ./my-research/ using the loop script. I have Codex CLI installed.
evals.expected_output: Recommends: bash scripts/autoresearch-loop.sh ./my-research/ with --cli codex flag, explains 3 execution modes (foreground/nohup/tmux), mentions check_progress.sh for monitoring. Does NOT recommend /loop or CronCreate (Codex-incompatible).
